acceptance.given: The skill-authoring standard source and its governed validation fixture are available for validation.

oracle.expected: Validation reports the standard as satisfying all nine required declarations: primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
forbidden: Validation accepts a fixture with any required declaration or referenced section removed.
Validation relies only on heading presence without identifying the rule and relative location.
oracle.observable: The validator output contains a successful A01 result and, for a negative fixture, a rule-specific failure with a relative source location.

acceptance.then: The validator confirms all nine declarations and rejects a governed fixture missing any required declaration with a rule and relative location.
acceptance.when: Run the repository skill-authoring plan validator against the standard and its governed positive and negative fixtures.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The A01 validator test must fail when the standard or its governed fixture omits any required declaration or when validation reports success without a rule-specific relative location.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure A01 validation enforces and reports all nine required standard declarations and rejects missing declarations with rule and relative-location diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; no persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: From unchecked or incompletely checked standard declarations to validator-confirmed complete declarations with deterministic negative-case diagnostics.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A01 validator tests pass, including positive completeness and negative missing-declaration cases with rule and relative-location output.
